note: Mitchell County TX: no county zoning layer found; county-level zoning is not published as a service. The only city with zoning, Colorado City, publishes its zoning districts map as a PDF (ZONING DISTRICTS MAP, 2013) and its ordinance as PDF text, with no ArcGIS REST, WFS or download of district polygons. Westbrook and Loraine showed no zoning GIS. The county's GIS app (experience.arcgis.com/experience/c86b811e922848d58ef2cfd110acf0b9) shows no reachable layers; the only zoning data found elsewhere is third-party (Regrid, Zoneomics), not official.
